email_subject: Application - Content Management Specialist (Drupal + SEO Ops)
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Content Management Specialist (Drupal + SEO Ops) position. With hands-on experience in Drupal and a strong background in on-page SEO and content quality assurance, I am confident in my ability to keep your digital properties accurate, up-to-date, and performing well.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage content across multiple WordPress sites, but I have also worked with Drupal in previous projects. I am highly detail-oriented and methodical, ensuring that every piece of content is error-free and consistent. My SEO knowledge includes on-page optimization, keyword research, and technical audits, which I have applied to improve organic visibility for clients and my own project, mirook.com.

I am comfortable working independently in a remote environment and coordinating with internal teams to ensure changes are implemented correctly and on schedule. I am bilingual in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Content Management Specialist (Drupal + SEO Ops) position. With a strong foundation in digital content management, on-page SEO, and quality assurance, I am well-prepared to support your team in maintaining accurate, high-performing digital properties.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted content that drives organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring content is uploaded and updated correctly. While my primary CMS experience is with WordPress, I have also worked with Drupal in previous roles and am quick to adapt to new systems. My attention to detail is meticulous; I regularly conduct QA checks on forms, links, and landing pages to identify and resolve issues before they escalate.

My SEO expertise extends to technical audits, structured data implementation, and entity optimization, which I have applied to my own project, mirook.com, to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I am comfortable working independently and coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure content changes are delivered accurately and on schedule.

I am based in Belgium and am fully equipped for remote work. I am bilingual in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level. I am eager to bring my operational rigor and proactive mindset to your team, ensuring that your digital properties remain accurate, consistent, and optimized.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your organization.

Sincerely,
